name: Asentimiento y Negación de Cabeza
description: Analiza movimientos de asentimiento y negación para detectar anomalías de deepfake
algorithm: Algoritmo de análisis Head Nod/Shake Pattern
mechanism:
This method analyzes head gesture dynamics for deepfake detection:

1. **Head Pose Seguimiento**: Head orientation (yaw, pitch, roll) is estimated per frame using facial landmark geometry or 3D head model fitting. Head pose signals are decomposed to identify gestural movements (nods = pitch oscillation, shakes = yaw oscillation).

2. **Gesture Kinematics Análisis**: Natural head gestures follow specific kinematics: (a) nodding involves 10-20° pitch oscillation at 1-2 Hz, (b) shaking involves 15-30° yaw oscillation at 1-2.5 Hz, (c) gestures show smooth sinusoidal profiles with physiologically constrained velocity. The method checks whether detected gestures fall within natural kinematic parameters.

3. **Gesture - Habla Correlación**: Head gestures correlate with speech prosody — nods often coincide with stressed syllables, head movements accompany turn-taking in conversation. The method analyzes temporal correlation between head motion and speech intensity. Deepfakes may show gestures temporally decoupled from speech.

4. **Neck - Head Coordination**: Head rotation involves coupled neck and cervical spine motion with characteristic ranges — large yaw rotations involve torso contribution. The method verifies head-neck-shoulder coordination. Deepfake generators that only manipulate the face may produce head rotations that don't propagate correctly to neck and shoulders.

5. **Inertial Consistencia**: Head motion should show proper inertial dynamics — acceleration/deceleration following the mass and muscle force constraints of the head-neck system. The method analyzes the frequency content and jerk profile of head motion. AI-generated head movements may lack natural inertial characteristics.
parameters: Tipo de análisis: estadístico automático\nRango de puntuación: 0 (auténtico) a 100 (generado por IA)
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-85% de precisión según la calidad de entrada.
source: Basado en investigación revisada por pares en forense digital y detección de contenido IA.
useCase: Se utiliza como parte del pipeline de análisis multiseñal para detectar contenido generado por IA.
strengths: • Metodología respaldada por investigación\n• Tiempo de cálculo rápido\n• Complementario a otros métodos de detección
limitations: • La precisión varía con la calidad de entrada\n• Mejor utilizado en combinación con otros métodos
